presets.coordinatorDecision: Standing coordinator rule (2026-09-26, from LAW-0687/0689-0692; docs/AUTHORING.md item 20). TRUE DRIVER: at 1:1 (and 9:16) the band above the exploded room is too narrow for six near-maximum relationship captions beside their own lines: the clock-unit and exhibit-room links are short (the lifted pieces sit close together in a narrow room), and every candidate place for their caption is within 20 px of another link or on a lifted piece, and the near-maximum element labels take the rest of the band. Tried before capping (text 22.5 down to 16.4 px): right-hand text column 0.24-0.36 of the width and text band under the diagram (2 and 3 columns); band share 0.26-0.44; room scale 1 and 1.2; tray lifted to the left or to the right; relation captions 10-64 px from their line at 7 positions along it, with 4 widths; element labels above, beside and below the pieces and anywhere on the free floor; relationship sets of 6 and 5 (with and without the clock link) and shorter relation captions (still one or two captions without a clear place at 1:1). Rendered numbers (final code, re-measured 2026-10-04 at the hold with production/scratch/hearings-01/capmeasure.mjs, 1080p-normalised, after the label-aware spacing of the lifted pieces) BEFORE the cap (six relationships, element labels 39-46 characters): 16:9 17.1 px text / people 80.6 px with every caption placed; 9:16 16.4 px / 117.6 px with one caption unplaced (rel-4); 1:1 16.4 px / 40.5 px with one caption unplaced (rel-4) and people under the floor (people-small). AFTER the cap (four relationships; element labels 25-39 characters, each longer than its baseline label; relation captions unchanged at near-maximum length): every caption placed — 16:9 22.5 px / 80.6 px, 9:16 21.6 px / 109.8 px, 1:1 16.4 px / 66.3 px. Counts stay >= baseline (4 relationships vs 3; traversal 4 vs 4); all other fields keep their near-maximum length. Pre-cap preset kept at production/scratch/hearings-01/LAW-0282.presets.precap.json.
